terms.definition: Any system that ingests metrics, logs and/or traces for monitoring, alerting, search or analysis (e.g. an OTEL Collector and its backends).
The act of forwarding OPC UA data into an observability system as OTEL metrics, logs or traces.

A transport-neutral association of a bound Object or type with exactly one OTEL signal — a metric set, a log stream, or a trace stream — and the mapping needed to emit it. Its bound items are homogeneous per binding: Variables for metrics, event fields for logs and traces.
A metric value, dimension, or event field that an observability binding exposes, with routing and semantic metadata.
The Object (an instance, or a type when authoring type‑level bindings) that a bound item's BrowsePath is resolved from.

The TypeDefinitionNode a binding is declared on — an ObjectType, an Interface (facet), or an AddInType (an Interface and an AddInType are themselves ObjectTypes). Its type‑level BrowsePaths resolve against any instance that is‑a the ObjectType, implements the Interface (`HasInterface`), or composes the AddInType (`HasAddIn`).
The OTEL signal a binding exposes: `Metrics`, `Logs` or `Traces`.
The small, domain‑agnostic classification a bridge uses to forward an item (Telemetry, Metric, Counter, Event, Dimension, …).
A bound item that is an OTEL attribute/label applied to every data point of its binding, rather than a measured value.
The retained link from a bound item back to the model node that defines it (TypeDefinition, BrowseName, namespace, dictionary entry).
A read-only Client whose sole purpose is to forward observable data from an OPC UA Server into an observability system, without understanding the domain semantics.
The concrete mechanism that carries a binding: classic OPC UA Subscriptions and Reads as the baseline, or optional Part 14 PubSub nodes (PublishedDataSet, DataSetWriter/Reader) where configured.
The Guid carried by Part 14 DataSetMetaData that identifies a binding/observability class independently of any Server instance.
